messages:
Sophie: Quick brain dump: propose a 'preflight' microbench stage on ingest that is hybrid: CPU lightweight checks first, then a tiny GPU smoke for candidates that show suspicious allocator behavior. Goal: catch obvious regressions cheaply. Thoughts?
Ranjit: I like hybrid. CPU-only missed a real regression last quarter where GPU allocator failed. What's the decision rule to trigger the GPU smoke?
Sophie: Heuristic: if CPU run shows >30% variance in memory growth or any CUDA-init errors captured in logs -> escalate to GPU smoke. Also always trigger GPU for certain families (large-params, fused kernels).
Mike: Cost angle: need to cap how many escalations per day. Suggest quota per-ingest-team and a weekly budget. If quota exhausted, mark as WARNING and require human review.
Priya: From infra side we can enforce quotas. Also the GPU smoke should run on preemptible pool with `--ephemeral` label so we don't starve prod.
Alexa: Artifact needs to be useful: minimal reproducible traces. Suggest artifact package: preflight.json (summary), trace.txt (fail traces), sample-outputs.log, docker-env.txt. All zipped as <model_id>-preflight-v2.tar.gz to S3: s3://intake/preflight/YYYY/MM/<model_id>/v2/<uuid>.
Sophie: Good. Also add an ingest manifest flag `preflight: {mode: "hybrid", corpus_id: "preflight-sample-2026-03"}` so we can update corpora centrally.
Ranjit: How deterministic should the corpus be? We should bind a small fixed seed and a 10-example set to keep noise low. If someone wants more coverage they can opt into full bench.
Priya: Operationally, we should attach a short TTL for artifacts (30 days) and a retention override for flagged FAILs. Where do we surface verdicts? admit-api should return pass/warn/fail enum.
Mike: Define clear semantics: PASS = within p50/p95 baselines +- 15%; WARN = outside but non-critical; FAIL = OOM, CUDA init errors, or p95 > 2x baseline. Also record numeric deltas in the artifact for audit.
Alexa: Can we reuse existing bench runner with a `--preflight-mode` flag to avoid onboarding a new binary? We can flip on extra logging and disable batching.
Sophie: Yes, reuse runtime binary with a wrapper. We'll also add a small shim to normalize outputs to the preflight schema. That keeps parity.
bench-ci: system: preflight-image build completed (sha: d34db33f) and pushed to registry.
Ranjit: Pilot plan: enable on new OSS and customer-private opt-in list for 3 weeks. Track cost, false-positive rate, and catches. We'll report weekly.
Priya: Add automation: if preflight returns FAIL, auto-create an incident card with attached artifact and tag oncall. Helps triage fast.
Mike: Edgecases: air-gapped customers must be able to opt-out with `preflight: {mode: "none", reason: "air-gapped"}` in manifest. Also make sure corpora references can be mirrored.
Sophie: I'll draft a tiny RFC follow-up: scope, gating heuristics, artifact schema v2, runbook snippet for triage, and pilot checklist. Meeting Friday 9am to review.
Alexa: I'll prepare the artifact schema and an example manifest patch and upload to the RFC draft.
Sophie: Great — thanks all. I'll open the PR and assign reviewers.
